metadata.datasource: FUJIFILM PROFESSIONAL DATA GUIDE, publication AF3-207U (FUJIFILM, 2005), p. 63: FUJICOLOR SUPERIA REALA [CS], ISO 100/21°, Daylight Type; spectral sensitivity (density 1.0 over D-min), characteristic curves (Status M, C-41/CN-16), spectral dye density (midscale neutral and D-min), digitised from the PDF's vector paths
metadata.copyright: SpektraLab product data. Not a spektrafilm profile; no array is read from one.
metadata.license: Built from FUJIFILM publication AF3-207U. See engine/resources_product/NOTICE.md.
metadata.method: spektrafilm's profile factory (9428440, GPL-3.0): D-min removed, speed point (green D 0.2) three stops under 0, C/M/Y dyes reconstructed from midscale neutral and D-min (dmid_dmin, generic starting dyes, masking couplers fitted), Status M unmixed, three normal CDFs per layer, D55 balance; then the shipped profiles' form reproduced from them: each dye at unit Status M density, sensitivity tails as an exponential approach (tau 120 nm), an sRGB 18 % grey at log exposure 0 through hanatos2025 (adaptation off), hanatos2025 window (erf4, widths 26.4/56.0 nm as the Portra NC/VC product profiles) + surface (poly4) fitted to Otsu, Munsell, UEF forest and Japan natural-object reflectances under D55, upstream's grey-ramp correction (Portra Endura, -2..+6 EV, trustability 1) run through the SpektraLab engine, CDFs refitted, mid grey re-anchored.

tags.log_sensitivity: SHEET inside the plotted range (relative axis: one grid interval = one decade, the sheet's '1.0' bar); ASSUMED tails (exponential approach); level FITTED (sRGB 18 % grey -> 0)
tags.density_curves: SHEET (Status M, unmixed), FITTED (3 CDFs per layer, grey-ramp scale/shift); ASSUMED beyond the plotted exposures (the CDFs' own toe and shoulder)
tags.channel_density: FITTED to the sheet's midscale neutral minus D-min (dmid_dmin model)
tags.base_density: SHEET (D-min curve; none outside the plotted range)
tags.midscale_neutral_density: SHEET (midscale neutral curve; none outside the plotted range)
tags.hanatos2025_adaptation: FITTED (reflectance sets above; window widths held at the Portra NC/VC product profiles')
tags.info: SHEET: process C-41/CN-16, ISO 100/21°, Daylight Type; ASSUMED antihalation strong, D55 reference, target print Crystal Archive Type II
tags.fourth_layer: SHEET draws a fourth, cyan-sensitive layer (dashed; Fujifilm's 4th colour layer). NOT MODELLED: the schema has three channels; its interlayer effect is not represented.

digitisation.labels_note: axis residual = largest gap between a tick label's value and the line fitted through the grid lines it labels

fit_residuals.dye_model: dmid_dmin (generic_a starting dyes, masking couplers fitted)
